notes.title: 1.01 version update log
notes.content:
[h3][/h3]

[olist]
[*]Increase ship painting options

[*]Optimize ship attributes, and increase shield restart ability for all player ships (the shield will restart within 3 minutes after it expires)

[*]Strengthen the attributes and capabilities of friendly ships

[*]Adjust the range of enemy forces

[*]Fix some bugs and achievement issues
[/olist]
